name: qwik-mascott
description: Bolt, the Qwik mascot: a painted explainer film of Qwik's JavaScript streaming and a Discord emoji set, built on ClaudeAnimationBase

scripts.audio: node audio/make.mjs && node audio/intro.mjs && node audio/verify.mjs
scripts.video: npm run audio && npm run frames && npm run export
scripts.build: node export_svg.mjs && node svg_to_gif.mjs && node pack.mjs
scripts.check: node export_svg.mjs && node svg_to_gif.mjs && node pack.mjs --check
